I develop open-source tools and reusable resources for research, academic writing, and teaching.

## Quarto Extensions

### MANIT templates

```{=html}
<div class="template-card">
  <a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-thesis" class="template-card-img-link"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-thesis/HEAD/manit-thesis.jpg" class="template-card-img" alt="MANIT PhD Thesis Template example"></a>
  <div class="template-card-body">
    <h4><a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-thesis">MANIT PhD Thesis Template</a></h4>
    <p>Format PhD theses according to MANIT (Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology) guidelines.</p>
    <pre class="template-card-cmd"><code>quarto use template ResearchInfuser/manit-thesis</code></pre>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="template-card">
  <a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-pre-thesis" class="template-card-img-link"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-pre-thesis/HEAD/manit-pre-thesis.jpg" class="template-card-img" alt="MANIT Pre-Thesis Synopsis Template example"></a>
  <div class="template-card-body">
    <h4><a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-pre-thesis">MANIT Pre-Thesis Synopsis Template</a></h4>
    <p>Format Pre-Thesis Synopsis submissions according to MANIT guidelines.</p>
    <pre class="template-card-cmd"><code>quarto use template ResearchInfuser/manit-pre-thesis</code></pre>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="template-card">
  <a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-presentation" class="template-card-img-link"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-presentation/HEAD/_extensions/presentation/_images/logo/manit_logo.png" class="template-card-img" alt="MANIT logo"></a>
  <div class="template-card-body">
    <h4><a href="https://github.com/ResearchInfuser/manit-presentation">MANIT Presentation Template</a></h4>
    <p>Create MANIT Bhopal presentations with the Metropolis theme design, in both Beamer (PDF) and RevealJS (HTML) formats.</p>
    <pre class="template-card-cmd"><code>quarto use template ResearchInfuser/manit-presentation</code></pre>
  </div>
</div>
```
